## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
RISK-OFF persists with elevated downside skew and weak breadth; market tone is deteriorating versus last week. Volatility elevated and flows favor Financials and select cyclicals.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Financials leading: COF (1W: +0.82% | 1M: +19.26%) ↑ rising ABOVE TREND, PNC (1W: +1.43% | 1M: +17.26%) ↑ rising ABOVE TREND. Consumer Discretionary and Materials follow: GM (1W: +0.79% | 1M: +20.16%) ↑ rising ABOVE TREND; FCX (1W: +0.67% | 1M: +19.90%) ↑ rising ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Utilities and Energy lag worst: AEP (1W: -0.05% | 1M: -7.78%) ↓ falling BELOW TREND; EOG (1W: -8.24% | 1M: -6.60%) ↓ falling BELOW TREND. Tech heavyweight weakness visible: MSFT (1W: -1.15% | 1M: -6.61%) ↓ falling BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top five by 1M: GM (1W: +0.79% | 1M: +20.16%) ↑ rising ABOVE TREND; FCX (1W: +0.67% | 1M: +19.90%) ↑ rising ABOVE TREND; COF (1W: +0.82% | 1M: +19.26%) ↑ rising ABOVE TREND; EL (1W: +1.29% | 1M: +18.34%) ↑ rising ABOVE TREND; PNC (1W: +1.43% | 1M: +17.26%) ↑ rising ABOVE TREND.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom five by 1M: EOG (1W: -8.24% | 1M: -6.60%) ↓ falling BELOW TREND; MSFT (1W: -1.15% | 1M: -6.61%) ↓ falling BELOW TREND; NOW (1W: -9.39% | 1M: -7.47%) ↓ falling BELOW TREND; TMUS (1W: +1.67% | 1M: -7.54%) ↑ rising BELOW TREND; AEP (1W: -0.05% | 1M: -7.78%) ↓ falling BELOW TREND.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Short-term leaders: TSLA (1W: +5.80% | 1M: +16.80%) ↑ rising ABOVE TREND; V (1W: +5.79% | 1M: +5.78%) ↑ rising ABOVE TREND; MA (1W: +4.71% | 1M: +5.10%) ↑ rising ABOVE TREND; BMY (1W: +4.70% | 1M: +14.54%) ↑ rising ABOVE TREND; LLY (1W: +4.52% | 1M: +1.65%) ↑ rising ABOVE TREND.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Mega-cap tech under pressure: AAPL (1W: -2.42% | 1M: +1.71%) ↓ falling BELOW TREND; MSFT (1W: -1.15% | 1M: -6.61%) ↓ falling BELOW TREND; NVDA (1W: -4.04% | 1M: -5.49%) ↓ falling BELOW TREND. META bucks the group: META (1W: +0.03% | 1M: +8.03%) → flat ABOVE TREND, but overall tech breadth weak.

8. Financials Outlook?
Financials are leadership anchor: JPM (1W: +1.53% | 1M: +4.82%) ↑ rising ABOVE TREND; V (1W: +5.79% | 1M: +5.78%) ↑ rising ABOVE TREND; MA (1W: +4.71% | 1M: +5.10%) ↑ rising ABOVE TREND. Sector strength broad-based—further upside if risk-off pressure eases.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Healthcare mixed but supportive: JNJ (1W: +1.39% | 1M: +5.59%) ↑ rising ABOVE TREND; UNH (1W: +1.29% | 1M: +4.47%) ↑ rising ABOVE TREND; LLY (1W: +4.52% | 1M: +1.65%) ↑ rising ABOVE TREND. PFE (1W: -2.59% | 1M: +0.12%) ↓ falling BELOW TREND—watch earnings/news sensitivity.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Overweight selective Financials and high-momentum cyclicals: COF, PNC, TSLA (all ABOVE TREND) for tactical gains; overweight FCX and GM into materials/auto strength. Underweight large-cap tech laggards MSFT and NVDA (both BELOW TREND) and Energy names showing breakdown like EOG (BELOW TREND).

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: TSLA (1W: +5.80% | 1M: +16.80%) ↑ rising ABOVE TREND — needs follow-through above this week's highs; V (1W: +5.79% | 1M: +5.78%) ↑ rising ABOVE TREND — watch volume. BEARISH: MSFT (1W: -1.15% | 1M: -6.61%) ↓ falling BELOW TREND — failure to reclaim 1M loss keeps downside risk; NVDA (1W: -4.04% | 1M: -5.49%) ↓ falling BELOW TREND — monitor for further distribution.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Financials and Consumer Discretionary for risk-on trades (financial leaders ABOVE TREND). BEARISH: Utilities and Energy remain vulnerable while Tech needs stabilization (key mega-caps BELOW TREND).

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
TSLA (1W: +5.80% | 1M: +16.80%) ↑ rising ABOVE TREND — trigger: decisive close above this week's high for continuation. NVDA (1W: -4.04% | 1M: -5.49%) ↓ falling BELOW TREND — trigger: reclaim of 1M range and positive 1W to shift trend. AAPL (1W: -2.42% | 1M: +1.71%) ↓ falling BELOW TREND — trigger: hold 1M support to avoid broader tech weakness. JPM (1W: +1.53% | 1M: +4.82%) ↑ rising ABOVE TREND — trigger: breakout above recent consolidation to add exposure.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

RISK-OFF remains and market breadth is worsening into month-end. Tactical opportunity in Financials and select cyclicals (COF, PNC, TSLA) as leaders; avoid weak mega-cap tech (MSFT, NVDA). Key risk is continued tech-led downside that drags broader indices and reduces risk appetite.
